primaryChecks.text: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”

context.text: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.
Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”

primaryChecks.text: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.

context.text: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

primaryChecks.text: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

context.text: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go out to war in Israel.”
“Take a census, from twenty years old and upward, as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These are those who came out of the land of Egypt.

primaryChecks.text: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

context.text: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

primaryChecks.text: They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.

context.text: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.
Moses and Eleazar the priest, with all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.

primaryChecks.text: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”

context.text: the land which the LORD struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”
Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?

primaryChecks.text: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”

context.text: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance.
Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before the LORD to the war,

primaryChecks.text: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before the LORD until he has driven out his enemies from before him,

context.text: Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before the LORD to the war,
and the land is subdued before the LORD; then afterward you shall return, and be clear of obligation to the LORD and to Israel. Then this land shall be your possession before the LORD.

primaryChecks.text: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;

context.text: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.
but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”

primaryChecks.text: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”

context.text: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As the LORD has said to your servants, so will we do.

Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.

primaryChecks.text: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

context.text: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.

primaryChecks.text: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.

context.text: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

primaryChecks.text: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

context.text: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.
Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

primaryChecks.text: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

context.text: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.

primaryChecks.text: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”

context.text: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.
Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;

primaryChecks.text: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”

context.text: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.
The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

primaryChecks.text: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

context.text: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance. You shall give pasture lands for the cities around them to the Levites.

primaryChecks.text: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

context.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

primaryChecks.text: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge.

context.text: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.
These six cities shall be refuge for the children of Israel, for the stranger, and for the foreigner living among them, that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

primaryChecks.text: These are the commandments and the ordinances which the LORD commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

context.text: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
